title: Every session and API token revoked
description: An emergency revocation ended at once every session and every API token, of people and of service accounts, but the break-glass session that ran it, if one did (HUM-10, ST-89). It records no event per session or token: this event records them all. Every use raises a security alert, as a break-glass use does. It carries no token, nor any hash of one.

actor.description: Who ran it: the platform administrator, from a session, or the break-glass custodian.

sessions.description: How many sessions it revoked: those that were not revoked before, expired ones included, since another replica's clock may not have reached their expiry.

tokens.description: How many API tokens it revoked: those that were not revoked before, expired ones included.
